questions.stem: A 25/M was found unresponsive at home. He has a history of intravenous drug abuse and human immunodefciency virus (HIV) with medical noncompliance. His last CD4 count was < 200/μL. A blood gas on room air reveals pH of 7.16, partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PCO2) of 70 mmHg, and partial pressure of oxygen (PO2) of 55 mmHg. Which of the following respiratory failure is predominantly seen?
